I have farmed this small rice plot near the mountain for many years. I did not go to school, so I do not know much about these new chemicals, and they cost too much money for a woman with only half a hectare of land. My family will do the work ourselves, and I will put cow manure on the field like we always do, because we keep some animals at home.
